projects.name: Investor Paradise
projects.description: A collaborative Python project whose README describes a multi-agent workflow combining NSE market analysis with PDF and web news research. It uses Google ADK and Gemini, with documented session management and evaluation workflows.
projects.note: Educational and informational research project; its outputs are not financial advice.

projects.name: Nirog Yoga
projects.description: My AI-assisted website work for Nirog Yoga. The repository is a JavaScript and Next.js project, and the live website brings together yoga programs, instructor information, and learning resources.
projects.note: Explore both the source repository and the live website.

projects.name: Distributed Systems
projects.description: Four vehicle-telemetry learning projects progressing from Java Kafka producers and consumers to Spring Boot applications, multiple consumer groups, PostgreSQL storage, retries, and dead-letter queue handling.
projects.note: A staged learning repository with shared Docker infrastructure.

projects.name: NSE Analysis
projects.description: A Jupyter notebook for exploring NSE equity, deliverable, and derivatives reports. Its documented workflow includes symbol and date selection, interactive charts, and CSV or HTML exports.
projects.note: Notebook-based analysis using local report data.

projects.name: Cypress with Allure
projects.description: A basic Cypress project structure with Allure report generation. The README explicitly describes it as a framework starter rather than a useful test suite.
projects.note: Archived on GitHub at the time of review; useful as a historical setup example.

projects.name: Python Utilities
projects.description: A collection described in its README as utility functions for Python. GitHub identifies Jupyter Notebook as its primary language, connecting reusable helpers with notebook-based exploration.
projects.note: The brief README leaves the individual helpers to be explored in the repository.
